resources.string: Draws local English labels over known untranslated JMGO text. No network access and no input automation.
Enable the accessibility service to draw English labels over known untranslated JMGO text in Settings, Launcher, Setup Guide, and System UI.
This service only traverses visible text when one of the four supported JMGO packages is active. It does not click, type, collect, store, or transmit anything.
